preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the sequence a is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The number of changes is between 0 and n.
The valid sequence has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n for vi in valid_sequence)
postconditions.description: Each element vi in the valid sequence is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for vi in valid_sequence if vi == i) == 1
postconditions.description: There is exactly one vertex i such that valid_sequence[i-1] == i (the root).

postconditions.expression: all(any(vi == valid_sequence[vj-1] for vj in range(1, n+1)) for vi in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For every vertex vi, there is a vertex vj such that valid_sequence[vj-1] == vi (each vertex has a parent except the root).
